spans.s: (an-eñja) adj. immobile, immovable, which leads to rebirth in the arūpāvacara state कर्माणि कुशलाकुशलानेञ्जानि

(an-eñjya) adj. immobile, immovable, which leads to rebirth in the group of gods belonging to the sphere of formless state, i. e. arūpāvacara state संस्काराः। ते च त्रिविधाः कुशला अकुशला आनेज्या (? अनेञ्ज्या)श्च
